Fluent setup rejected:
  recon/cell-lsf?: warped-face gradient correction is not implemented; opt in with --approximate wfgc to run without warped-face gradient correction (WFGC off, #f); effect: src/kutta/fv/VERIFICATION.md#v6-initialization-comparison

issues.label: Wall roughness
issues.explanation: Fluent modifies the wall law using roughness height and constant. Kutta currently implements the smooth-wall SST law, so roughness drag and y-plus cannot be reproduced. Adapter detail: inactive model flag retained; does not apply to the selected viscous model.

issues.label: Energy equation
issues.explanation: Fluent solves temperature or enthalpy. Kutta omits energy; it is decoupled from momentum only when all active density and viscosity laws are constant. Temperature results are unavailable. Adapter detail: energy ignored (decoupled): constant density and viscosity.

issues.label: Warped-face gradient correction
issues.explanation: Fluent corrects gradients for nonplanar faces. Kutta does not yet implement Fluent's warped-face correction and will run with WFGC off only when you opt in with --approximate wfgc. V6 CPU hybrid diagnostic versus Fluent: velocity L2 3.601459%, pressure L2 2.961922%, k L2 15.478919%, omega L2 8.474918%, pressure-drop error 1.185077%; combined solver discrepancy, not isolated WFGC error or a general bound.
